verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's own docs confirm that fields, layouts, and custom views exist as product entities (via the metadata API), and that users can build custom modules. Nothing shows that an ops user can create custom fields or build filtered, sorted, shared views in the UI without admin involvement. Missing for 10: documentation of UI-based custom field creation, view filter/sort/share controls, non-admin permission to do these, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
